claim.claim-text: 1. A waveguide display system (1400), comprising:

prevent the divergent reflected light beam (1455) from the scanning mirror (1420) from propagating to the outcoupling DOE (1448) in the waveguide (1442) through total internal reflection (TIR); and cause the collimated reflected light beam (1460) to propagate to the outcoupling DOE (1448) in the waveguide (1442) through total internal reflection (TIR).
2. The waveguide display system (1400) of claim1, wherein the incoupling DOE (1446) is a periodic grating having a pitch configured to selectively incouple light beams of different incident angles.

3. The waveguide display system (1400) of claim1, wherein the point light source comprises a fiber point light source (1415) including an optical fiber (1410) having a tip with an angled facet, and the optical fiber (1410) is configured to emit a light beam in a direction at an angle with respect to an axis of the optical fiber.
4. The waveguide display system (1400) of claim1, wherein the point light source (1415) comprises a cantilever scanner with a waveguide.

5. The waveguide display system (1400) of claim 1, wherein an angle of incidence of the diverging input light beam (1411), the collimated reflected light beam (1460), and a grating period of the incoupling DOE (1446) are configured to determine diffraction angles, such that the diverging input light beam (1411) transmitted through the incoupling DOE (1446) does not satisfy a TIR condition for the diverging input light beam to propagate to the outcoupling DOE (1448), and the collimated reflected light beam (1460) reaching the incoupling DOE (1446) satisfies the TIR condition to propagate to the outcoupling DOE (1448).
6. The waveguide display system (1400) of claim 1, wherein

diffraction of the diverging input light beam (1411) by the incoupling DOE (1446) produces a first negative first order diffracted light beam that fails total internal reflection (TIR) condition of the waveguide; and diffraction of the collimated reflected light beam (1460) by the incoupling DOE (1446) produces a second negative first order diffracted light beam that meets the TIR condition of the waveguide.

7. The waveguide display system (1400) of claim 1, wherein the divergent input light beam (1411), the divergent reflected light beam (1455), and collimated reflected light beam (1460) are incident on the waveguide (1442) at an angle with respect to a normal of the waveguide.

8. The waveguide display system (1400) of claim 1, wherein the outcoupling DOE (1148) comprises a diffraction grating configured to diffract a portion of the collimated reflected light beam (1460) out of the waveguide (1442).

11. The waveguide display system (2300) of claim 9, wherein the collimating optical element (2230) comprises a mirror with positive optical power, for example, a concave mirror.

12. The waveguide display system (2300) of claim 9, wherein the scanning optical element (2240) is a one-axis scanning mirror that scans in a direction orthogonal to a scan direction of the cantilever scanner.

13. The waveguide display system (2300) of claim 9, wherein the cantilever scanner (2210), the reflective optical element (2220), the collimating optical element (2230), and the scanning optical element (2240) are disposed on a same side of the waveguide (2342), adjacent to the first surface (2321).

14. The waveguide display system (2300) of claim 9, wherein the cantilever scanner (2210), the reflective optical element (2220), the collimating optical element (2230), and the scanning optical element (2240) are disposed on a same side of the waveguide (2342), adjacent to the second surface (2322).

15. The waveguide display system (2300) of claim 9, wherein the scanning optical element (2240) comprises a square or triangle shaped structure that constantly rotates at the same speed and in the same direction, generating a plane image from a one-dimensional line scan.
